In the small kitchen in Lagos, Nkechi put her phone on the low stool. "No, Chidi. Don't touch."
Chidi, two, looked at her, then at the phone. His hand shot out at once. Nkechi moved it higher. He climbed onto the stool, reaching and shouting, "Mine!"
From the doorway, Yara, the neighbour, laughed. "He only wants it because you said no."
Nkechi handed him a wooden spoon and a pot lid. He banged them hard, the phone forgotten.

qa.q: Where did Nkechi first put her phone?
qa.a: Nkechi put her phone on the low stool.

qa.q: Why do you think Chidi reached for the phone right after hearing "No"?
qa.a: Being told not to touch made the phone seem more exciting 😊, and grabbing it let Chidi show he wanted to decide for himself.

qa.q: What worked for Nkechi in the end?
qa.a: Giving Chidi things he was allowed to use, a wooden spoon and a pot lid, so his push to do his own thing had a safe outlet.

qa.q: How does Yara see what is happening?
qa.a: Yara finds it funny and can see that Chidi only wants the phone because he was told no.

grounding: It shows a toddler reaching for something the moment he is told not to touch it, the ban making it more attractive.

qa.q: What could Mummy try instead of saying no again?
qa.a: She could calmly move the pot out of reach and give Siddharth a small tub of mud or water he is allowed to play with.

qa.q: How does Pradeep see Siddharth's behaviour?
qa.a: Pradeep watches with curiosity rather than anger, guessing the pot became the most interesting thing once it was forbidden.

grounding: It shows a toddler going straight for a plant pot the moment he is told not to touch it, as noticed by an older sibling.

Crèche note, Christmas week, by the room caregiver.

Today Abhinav's mother Kavitha visited during our decorating time. When I said, "Abhinav, don't pull the tinsel," he walked straight to the tree and yanked it, looking back at me. He laughed when I came near.

qa.a: He seemed excited and pleased with himself, as the no made the tinsel more tempting and let him show his own will.

qa.a: Giving Abhinav his own tinsel to shake and moving the glass baubles higher kept him safe and happy.
